why: Near miss: Intro to CAD lesson 10 ("A watertight STL of the hook is saved"). The learner had the sketch selected, not the Body, when choosing File > Export > STL, so hook.stl holds no triangles at all (solid Mesh / endsolid Mesh). The file exists and starts like an STL; a slicer would show nothing.

step.title: Export an STL to print
step.instructions: Select the Body in the tree, choose File > Export, pick STL Mesh (*.stl) and save it as hook.stl next to hook.FCStd.
